column1: # The cost of each leg of Layer C1bnl in seconds, by the leg's key (`nondefault-tests-gate.sh
# --list-legs`): what `census_shard_plan.py` deals the legs to the hosted C1bnl shards by,
# heaviest first to the least loaded shard. The weights decide balance only, never which legs run:
# a leg with no row is planned at the median and named on stderr, and a row whose key no leg has is
# Measured on hosted run 45654176488 (65283e430), its four shards read in full, and where a leg
# printed no time there (it failed) on run 45595433755 (913bfef90), else the row before; 45 legs
# that failed on both carry no row and are planned at the median. Each leg's cost is the time the
# gate prints after it, its build included. Refresh from a run log: the gate prints
# `[<key>, <N>s]` after every leg. The comment after a row is the leg's label.
